vibe: luxurious, nurturing, peaceful, emotionally comforting, premium, modern, trustworthy, feminine, and elegant

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-medium

typography.notes: Use tracking-tight for all headings. Never use Inter. Apply Playfair Display for headings and Outfit for body text.

surfaces_and_shadows.cards: bg-white border border-[#F3EFEA] shadow-sm rounded-2xl overflow-hidden

motion_and_animations.image_reveal: Use framer-motion to reveal images with a slow scale-down effect (1.1 to 1) combined with a soft blur-to-clear transition
motion_and_animations.scroll_animations: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' for elegant fade-up animations on sections as the user scrolls. Use lenis for smooth scrolling.

components.buttons: Rounded-full, px-8 py-3. Use elegant_gold for primary buttons. Add subtle scale on hover.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: rounded-xl, bg-white/50, border-[#F3EFEA], focus:ring-[#C5A880]/50
components.navigation: Sticky header with glassmorphism surface. Must have logo, navigation links, and a primary CTA. Links should have a subtle underline animation on hover.
components.footer: Generous padding (py-32). Darker earth tone background (#2D2A26) with text in Warm Ivory to create contrast at the end of the page.
components.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}) to match the elegant serif aesthetic.

hero_background.description: Wide-angle cinematic background, warm ivory and pastel peach tones, soft light gradients, subtle elegant gold accents, smooth organic curves

abstract_nurture.description: Abstract flowing silk in soft lavender and warm beige, delicate translucent layers

beige_gold_texture.description: Minimalist soft beige and gold texture background, fine grain paper texture

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure pure HTML + Tailwind CSS is used for structural and visual layouts (especially marketing sections).
Use Shadcn UI primarily for complex interactive elements (forms, select, calendar). Customize them to match the premium brand aesthetic.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Avoid center-aligning everything; utilize varied bento grids and asymmetric layouts to create visual tension and elegance.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively. Never use placeholder images.
Implement glassmorphism selectively for sticky navigation and premium feature cards, ensuring contrast is maintained.
Use text shadows or gradient overlays to ensure text readability over images.
